DexCom 10-K supply chain single source suppliers risk factors

findings.claim: FY2023 10-K：DexCom 依賴單一或唯一來源供應商，例如發射器內的 ASIC 與生物介面膜用的特定聚合物
findings.excerpt: However, we also rely on single and/or sole sources for certain components and materials used in manufacturing, such as for the application-specific integrated circuit that is incorporated into the transmitter and certain polymers used to synthesize the polymeric biointerface membranes for our products.

findings.claim: 風險摘要站稱 DexCom 製造集中於亞利桑那州梅薩與馬來西亞，聖地牙哥有限，替代產能難以快速建立（二手摘要，非 SEC 原文）
findings.excerpt: Most manufacturing is concentrated in Mesa, Arizona and Malaysia (limited in San Diego), with replacement capacity hard to stand up quickly.

findings.claim: 2025 Q1 電話會議 CFO 稱因多數產品在美國製造，關稅直接衝擊較小、預期無重大影響
findings.source: MDDI: Did Dexcom Return to Form with its 1Q25 Earnings?
